title: Shopify opens checkout to browser-based AI agents | TechCrunch
summary: This update introduces three new tools — get_checkout, update_checkout, and complete_checkout — that allow agents to inspect a checkout, change things like the customer’s address or delivery option, and then place an order after the buyer authorizes it.
